evidence.context: Fictional post-meeting drafting workshop. Review and closure are workshop package names. No decision changes either official vote.
evidence.rule: Which package may the workshop chair recommend? Each delegate accepts the package on their private card only. If both accept the same package, recommend it. Otherwise record an impasse.
evidence.status-638: France and the United Arab Emirates submitted S/2023/638. It proposed renewing the sanctions and extending the Panel of Experts. The tally was 13 in favour, 1 against and 1 abstention. Russia cast the sole negative vote and the draft was not adopted due to the negative vote of a permanent member. France supported it and China abstained.
evidence.status-639: Russia submitted S/2023/639 as a separate draft. It proposed a final extension of the sanctions and immediate dissolution of the Panel of Experts. Russia voted in favour, Japan against and all other members including France and China abstained. It was not adopted, having received 1 vote in favour, 1 against and 13 abstentions.
evidence.card-1: first delegate has the workshop card review.
evidence.missing: No workshop card was delivered from the second delegate.
